QuestInfo.name: After Centuries 1
QuestInfo.0: A town like this couldn't spring up overnight. How many years have passed? Will the people here even understand your language?
QuestInfo.1: You recognize the people of this town as Sylphs, one of the younger races of Fairies. Perhaps that #bboy with silver hair#k can tell you what's going on.
QuestInfo.2: #p1032106# wasn't very friendly. At any rate, you learned that you were asleep for centuries. Furthermore, #p1032106# says that the Elves disappeared long, long ago...

0.0: There wasn't anything but wilderness here before. How many years have passed? Will the people here even understand my language? I suppose there's one way to find out. Who should I talk to first...?
0.1: Wait... These people are the Sylphs! Before the curse, they were one of the younger races of Fairy... If they have a town of their own, they've come a long way while I slept in the ice.
0.2: This #bsilver-haired boy#k looks nice enough. I'll start with him.

yes.0: Greetings, child. Might I have a moment of your time?

no.0: But before I approach, I should make sure I'm ready. After all, I'm a representative of the noble Elves!

1.0: What? I got a lot of homework to do. Buzz off, human! \r\n#L0##bY-you impudent...! How DARE you?! And where do you get off, calling me a human of all things?!#l\n#k
1.1: Haha, you talk funny! If you're not a human, what are you? You don't look like any Fairy I ever saw. You don't even have wings!\r\n#L0##bOf course I don't have wings, you ingrate! I'm an Elf!#l\n#k
1.2: ...Elf? Huh, that sounds familiar. Elf, Elf, Elf... Weren't they that race of Fairies that #rdisappeared hundreds of years ago?#k\r\n#L0##bH-hundreds of years?!#l\n#k
1.3: That's what I learned in school, anyway. They were all...um... Okay, I don't remember what happened to them. I also heard there's one elf that... Hey, are you listening? Hello?!

0.msg: #b(...Hundreds of years? The Elves are all gone? How is this possible?!)#k

npc.0: This #b#p1032106##k seems nice enough. I'll start by talking to him.
